edges.notes: 20-year PPA for the 835 MW restarted Three Mile Island Unit 1 (Crane Clean Energy Center), online ~2028. Price not disclosed.
20-year PPA for 1,121 MW Clinton Clean Energy Center (+30 MW uprate), deliveries from June 2027. Terms not disclosed.
Up to 1,920 MW from Susquehanna through 2042. Talen cites ~$18B notional revenue over the contract life at full quantity (investor presentation / 2025 annual report).
20-year PPAs for >2,600 MW (2,176 MW operating + 433 MW uprates) from Perry, Davis-Besse and Beaver Valley. Financial terms not disclosed.
Supports Oklo's planned 1.2 GW advanced-reactor campus in Pike County, Ohio, for Meta's data centers. Part of Meta's up-to-6.6 GW nuclear package; terms not disclosed.
25-year PPA for the 615 MW Duane Arnold nuclear plant restart (target Q1 2029). Price not disclosed.
Framework for >10.5 GW of new renewable capacity 2026-2030. Brookfield said it would drive >$10B of investment; that is capex, not contract value, so magnitude left null.
Hydro framework up to 3,000 MW; first 20-year contracts (Holtwood, Safe Harbor, 670 MW) worth >$3B of power.
On-site fuel-cell power; 1.2 GW contracted of up to 2.8 GW intended. Contract value not disclosed. Oracle also received a ~$400M warrant on Bloom stock (CNBC, 2026-04-13).

After OpenAI's recapitalization Microsoft holds ~27% of OpenAI Group PBC on an as-converted diluted basis, valued at ~$135B at the time. Later 2026 rounds dilute this; 27% is the last reported figure.

$8B invested 2023-2024 plus $5B in April 2026, with up to $20B more contingent on milestones. Ownership % not disclosed; Amazon's Q2-2026 10-Q carries the nonvoting preferred at ~$92.5B (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001018724/000101872426000026/amzn-20260630.htm), so stake_pct is left null rather than derived.

More than $3B invested 2023-2025 plus $10B in April 2026; up to $30B more contingent on milestones. Earlier reporting put Google's stake near 14% with a 15% cap, but no current percentage is disclosed, so stake_pct is null.
Commitment to invest up to $5B. Ownership % not disclosed.
Commitment to invest up to $10B. Huang said in March 2026 this would likely be NVIDIA's last Anthropic check.
$30B equity in OpenAI's 2026 round, not tied to deployment milestones. Replaced the September-2025 letter of intent for up to $100B, which never became binding.
Up to $50B - $15B initial, $35B contingent on milestones incl. an IPO or direct listing (per SEC filings as reported by GeekWire). Ownership % not disclosed.

Warrant for up to 160M AMD shares (~10% of AMD at announcement), vesting with GPU deployments and AMD share-price targets. AMD's 10-Q says no tranche had vested as of 2026-06-27, so stake_pct is null (contingent).
Performance-based warrant for up to 160M AMD shares at $0.01, vesting with GPU shipments (first 1 GW) and AMD price thresholds up to $600/share. Contingent, so stake_pct is null.
$14.3B for a 49% non-voting stake at a ~$29B valuation; Scale founder Alexandr Wang joined Meta.
AMD said it will invest up to $5B in Anthropic "in the future" as part of a compute partnership.

~$300B of compute over ~5 years starting 2027, first reported by the WSJ alongside Oracle's RPO disclosure (TechCrunch, 2025-09-10); OpenAI later confirmed the figure (https://www.cnbc.com/2025/10/15/a-guide-to-1-trillion-worth-of-ai-deals-between-openai-nvidia.html). Part of Stargate's 4.5 GW Oracle expansion.
OpenAI committed to purchase an incremental $250B of Azure services; Microsoft gave up its right of first refusal on OpenAI compute.
$38B AWS agreement (Nov 2025, https://www.cnbc.com/2025/11/03/open-ai-amazon-aws-cloud-deal.html) expanded by $100B over eight years in Feb 2026, incl. at least 2 GW of Trainium.
Anthropic committed to purchase $30B of Azure compute, plus up to 1 GW additional capacity on NVIDIA Grace Blackwell / Vera Rubin.
Anthropic plans to spend more than $100B on AWS over ten years for up to 5 GW (Trainium2-4, Graviton). Figure is a floor ("more than").

Anthropic's IPO prospectus (as reported) shows a $125.2B five-year TPU capacity lease commitment. Builds on the Oct-2025 1M-TPU deal (https://www.cnbc.com/2025/10/23/anthropic-google-cloud-deal-tpu.html) and the April-2026 Google/Broadcom expansion. Part of this capacity is delivered via Broadcom (see avgo -> anthropic).
Anthropic leases all of Colossus 1 (>300 MW, >220k NVIDIA GPUs). SpaceX's prospectus puts it at $1.25B per month through May 2029; terminable on 90 days' notice.
Google pays SpaceX $920M per month for compute at xAI data centers, October 2026 through June 2029.
Up to $11.9B (Mar 2025) + $4B (May 2025) + $6.5B (Sep 2025) = ~$22.4B total contract value per CoreWeave. Ceilings, not guaranteed spend.
OpenAI received $350M of CoreWeave stock as part of the March 2025 agreement.

Sum of two separately announced commitments - up to ~$14.2B through Dec 2031 (Sep 2025, https://www.cnbc.com/2025/09/30/coreweave-meta-deal-ai.html) and ~$21B expanded agreement through Dec 2032 (Apr 2026). Summation is ours.
CoreWeave deal to provide capacity for Claude; contract value not disclosed in the coverage reviewed, so magnitude is null and confidence estimated.
Five-year dedicated GPU capacity at Vineland, NJ; ~$17.4B through 2031, up to ~$19.4B if Microsoft buys additional capacity.

Up to ~$27B over five years ($12B dedicated Vera Rubin capacity + up to $15B additional). Follows a ~$3B Nov-2025 agreement (https://nebius.com/blog/posts/digest-november-2025); overlap between the two is not disclosed, so only the larger figure is used.
Five-year access to NVIDIA GB300 GPUs at Childress, TX; ~$9.7B total contract value incl. 20% prepayment.
IREN agreed to buy GPUs and ancillary equipment from Dell for ~$5.8B to serve the Microsoft contract.
Six-year Google Cloud deal worth more than $10B (anonymous sources; first reported by The Information). Figure is a floor.

750 MW of Cerebras compute through 2028. Initially reported as >$10B (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/01/14/cerebras-scores-openai-deal-worth-over-10-billion.html); Cerebras's S-1/A describes it as valued at more than $20B. OpenAI also extended a $1B working-capital loan.
$2B of Class A stock at $87.20/share (Jan 2026), on top of a pre-existing ~7% stake reported in 2025. Current ownership % not disclosed in sources reviewed.
NVIDIA agreed to buy up to $6.3B of CoreWeave's unsold cloud capacity through April 2032 (capacity backstop).
NVIDIA $2B investment in Nebius (March 2026). Ownership % not disclosed.
10 GW of OpenAI-designed accelerators + Broadcom Ethernet racks, deploying H2-2026 through 2029. Financial terms not disclosed; first chip revealed June 2026.
Long-term agreement (through 2031) for Broadcom to develop and supply custom TPUs plus networking for Google. Value not disclosed (one analyst estimate of >$50B over 5 years is not used).

Broadcom's previously unnamed $10B-order customer is Anthropic (TPU racks); April 2026 filing adds ~3.5 GW accessed via Broadcom from 2027, and Broadcom agreed to lend Anthropic up to $42B (Oct 2026). Order totals overlap with the googl -> anthropic TPU lease, so magnitude is null here to avoid double counting.
Multi-generation MTIA custom-accelerator partnership through 2029 with an initial commitment exceeding 1 GW. Value not disclosed.
Multiyear, multigenerational deal for millions of Blackwell and Rubin GPUs, Grace/Vera CPUs and networking. Price not disclosed.
Up to 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, first 1 GW of MI450 in H2-2026. AMD expects "tens of billions" of revenue but no figure was disclosed.
Up to 6 GW of AMD GPUs (custom MI450-based) and EPYC CPUs; binding commitment for the first 1 GW. TechCrunch reported "up to $100B" but neither company confirmed a value, so magnitude is null.
OCI to deploy 50,000 AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs starting calendar Q3 2026. Value not disclosed.
Five-year, multi-generational agreement covering custom AI products, optical/AEC DSPs, retimers and switching silicon. Marvell's role as Trainium ASIC partner is per analyst/press reporting.
214,776,632 Intel shares at $23.28 (closed Dec 2025), alongside joint custom x86 CPU / RTX-SoC products. Stake % depends on Intel's share count, which the pipeline does not back-solve.
$2B of Synopsys common stock at $414.79/share as part of a multiyear GPU-accelerated EDA partnership.
Warrant for up to 58,970,907 Marvell shares at $206.58 (~$12.2B notional), mostly vesting one tranche per $500M of Google custom-silicon purchases through FY2033. Contingent, so stake_pct is null.
Custom-silicon programs attached to the TPU ecosystem (inference accelerators, NICs, storage/memory controllers). Value not fixed; warrant vesting implies purchases measured in $500M tranches.
Meta was 21% of Arista revenue in FY2023 (26% FY2022). Arista stopped naming customers after FY2023, so this is the latest named share.
Microsoft was 18% of Arista revenue in FY2023 (latest year customers were named).
400 MW across three ~15-year leases at Polaris Forge 1 (Ellendale, ND); ~$11B anticipated aggregate lease revenue.
Up to $6B for data-center fiber-optic cable through 2030; Meta anchors a Corning plant expansion in North Carolina.
Bloomberg-reported ~$5B GB200 server deal with xAI (now part of SpaceX); Dell declined to comment and finalisation was not confirmed.
Supermicro co-building a gigawatt AI data center for SpaceX/xAI (CEO statement, June 2026); also named by Musk as a Colossus supplier in 2024. Value not disclosed.
Dell shipped the first GB300 NVL72 racks to CoreWeave (and GB200 before it). Value not disclosed.

Celestica describes itself as a preferred manufacturing partner for Google's TPU systems and is expanding US and Southeast Asia capacity for them (FY2025 results). Its top customer was 32% of 2025 revenue but is unnamed, so no share is attributed to Google.
Credo does not name hyperscaler customers; analysts cite Amazon and Microsoft. Treated as estimated.
Analyst-cited customer (company does not name customers).
Named NVIDIA 800 VDC power-architecture partner; reference designs for Rubin Ultra / Kyber AI factories. Exposure is to NVIDIA platform adoption, not NVIDIA as a buyer.
800 VDC reference architecture developed in collaboration with NVIDIA.
800 VDC power systems for NVIDIA's next-generation GPU racks (named NVIDIA data-center power partner).
SK Group / NVIDIA partnership covering next-generation memory supply; SK hynix is NVIDIA's primary HBM supplier (HBM3E for Blackwell, HBM4 for Rubin). Volumes and value not disclosed.
Micron HBM3E 8H/12H designed into NVIDIA B200/GB200/B300/GB300; SOCAMM co-developed for GB300. Value not disclosed.
Samsung reports the industry's first mass-product sales of HBM4 and SOCAMM2 for NVIDIA Vera Rubin (Q1 2026). Share of NVIDIA's HBM4 not disclosed.
Korean press reports Samsung was designated primary HBM4 supplier for AMD MI455X (Helios). Not exclusive; share undisclosed.
Letter of intent - Samsung as strategic memory partner for Stargate; OpenAI's demand projected at up to 900k DRAM wafers/month (shared with SK hynix). Non-binding.
SK hynix named a Stargate memory partner; Samsung + SK hynix target 900k DRAM wafer starts/month. Non-binding.
NVIDIA is (per Huang and analysts) TSMC's largest customer in 2026; analyst estimates put it near 20% of TSMC revenue in 2025. TSMC does not name customers, so no share is recorded.
Cerebras's S-1/A - TSMC is the source of its entire wafer supply (WSE-3 on TSMC 5nm), with no long-term allocation commitment.
Microsoft chose an (unnamed) chip design to produce on Intel 18A. Not confirmed to be Maia. Low volume per later reporting.
Samsung was 12% of Applied Materials net revenue in FY2024 (10-K major-customer table).
TSMC was 11% of Applied Materials net revenue in FY2024 (19% in FY2023).
Lam's FY2025 10-K names Samsung and TSMC as its most significant customers; per-customer percentages are disclosed unnamed, so no share is recorded.
Named most-significant customer in Lam's FY2025 10-K (percentage not attributed by name).
TSMC is KLA's only >10% customer (FY2024-FY2026 per 10-K); a single customer was ~20% of revenue for 9M to March 2025 (10-Q). Exact FY share not extracted, so null.

Named among Tokyo Electron's major customers in its 2024 integrated report data section. Revenue shares in that table could not be verified first-hand (encrypted PDF), so none are recorded; date is the fiscal year-end covered.
Named among Tokyo Electron's major customers in its 2024 integrated report data section. Revenue shares not recorded (could not be verified first-hand); date is the fiscal year-end covered.
Named among Tokyo Electron's major customers in its 2024 integrated report data section. Revenue shares not recorded (could not be verified first-hand); date is the fiscal year-end covered.
Intel is the first High-NA EUV customer in volume production (18A, >1M wafers processed). High-NA tools are ~$400M each; total Intel spend not disclosed.
TSMC is ASML's largest EUV customer (ASML does not name customers) and plans High-NA adoption ~2030.
Samsung plans High-NA EUV for DRAM from 2028.
Barclays estimate (via CNBC) that SK hynix takes 12 ASML EUV tools in 2026. Analyst estimate, not a disclosed order.
Expanded partnership integrating Cadence EDA/system design with NVIDIA CUDA-X and Omniverse; NVIDIA is also a long-standing Cadence EDA user. No equity or contract value disclosed.
Arm's Q1 FYE27 results cite NVIDIA's 88-core Arm-based Vera CPU as a data-center royalty driver. Arm does not break out royalties by customer.

Claude offered inside Palantir's IL6 platform on AWS for US defense/intelligence. Note the March-2026 Pentagon "supply chain risk" designation of Anthropic (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/09/anthropic-was-the-pentagons-choice-for-ai-now-its-banned-and-experts-are-worried.html) curtails defense use.
Claude is a preferred model in Agentforce for regulated industries; Salesforce deploys Claude Code internally.
OpenAI models as a preferred/default LLM option in Agentforce 360; Agentforce apps and commerce in ChatGPT.
Claude is the default model for ServiceNow Build Agent and a preferred model across its AI Platform.
Three-year deal making OpenAI models a preferred capability on ServiceNow; terms not disclosed.
Multi-year $200M partnership bringing Claude to Snowflake's ~12,600 customers and powering Snowflake Intelligence.
$200M partnership bringing OpenAI models into Snowflake.
Databricks committed to at least $100M of OpenAI model spend over several years (GPT-5 flagship in Agent Bricks).
OpenAI image generation offered as a partner model inside Adobe Firefly.
Google Imagen/Veo/Gemini image models offered as partner models in Firefly and Photoshop.

Cursor (Anysphere) was reported as one of Anthropic's biggest API customers. SpaceX closed its $60B acquisition of Cursor on 2026-08-14 (https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/15/spacex-officially-closes-its-cursor-acquisition/), so the relationship now sits on SpaceX. Spend not disclosed.

Amazon anchored X-energy's ~$500M Series C-1 (2024). A Form 3 filed at the April-2026 IPO reports 65,836,948 Class A shares held by an Amazon subsidiary; stake % left to the pipeline (not back-solved here).
Amazon holds options to bring >5 GWe of Xe-100 projects online by 2039 (first project 320-960 MWe with Energy Northwest) and first-priority manufacturing slots 2031-2039. Options, not firm offtake.
Claude distributed through Amazon Bedrock (since 2023); Claude Platform also available on AWS under the April-2026 agreement.
Claude available in Microsoft Foundry and across Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot and Copilot Studio.
Meta's investment came with deeper work producing training data for Meta's models; OpenAI and Google reportedly wound down Scale work afterwards.

ASML invested EUR 1.3B leading Mistral's Series C (Sep 2025, https://www.asml.com/news/press-releases/2025/asml-mistral-ai-enter-strategic-partnership) and held ~11.1% fully diluted at 2025-12-31 per its 20-F; diluted somewhat by the Sep-2026 Series D. EUR amount kept out of magnitude_usd to avoid an FX-dated conversion.

Samsung Electronics led Mistral's EUR 3B Series D (>EUR 21B post-money). Samsung's own check size and stake are not disclosed. Paired with a partnership to deploy Mistral across Samsung semiconductor operations.
Undisclosed investment plus Vera Rubin access. Bloomberg reported ~$5B, but neither company confirmed the figure, so magnitude is null.
SSI uses Google Cloud TPUs; Google Cloud reported as its primary compute provider. Terms not disclosed.
An undisclosed "significant investment" alongside a multi-year partnership to deploy at least 1 GW of Vera Rubin systems (https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/nvidia-partnership/).
First cloud deal, "single-digit billions" per a source (no point figure, so null), on GB300 systems. Non-exclusive.
NVIDIA participated in Cohere's $500M round at $6.8B (also an investor since 2023). Check size not disclosed.
AMD Ventures is a Cohere investor; Cohere also partnered with AMD to run Command models on Instinct GPUs.
Cohere Command, Rerank and Embed models offered in the OCI Generative AI service (May 2025 release notes); Cohere also powers generative-AI features in Oracle Fusion Applications.
29 LM2500XPRESS aeroderivative gas turbines (~1 GW) for Crusoe's AI data centers. Value not disclosed.
Crusoe develops the 1.2 GW Abilene, TX Stargate campus; Oracle is the tenant/operator serving OpenAI. Lease value not disclosed.
Memorandum of understanding to explore a ~300 MW SMR near North Anna, Virginia. Exploratory, not a PPA, so confidence is estimated.
